info.title: ASELCO Member & Admin API
info.description:
Versioned surface for Phases 2–6 (wallet, tickets/complaints, notifications)
plus membership/customer-service helpers the mobile app already uses.

**Base path:** `/api/v1`

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {sanctum_token}` from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
Customer routes also require a verified email. Admin wallet requires a role in
`config('ast.load_wallet_roles')`. Admin tickets require `canManageTickets()`.

**Success convention (do not wrap):** JSON is the resource, Laravel paginator,
or `{ message, ...fields }`. Mutations may include `code` on domain errors.

**Error convention:** `{ "message": string, "code": string, "errors"?: object }`
